question: How does anything first appear in reflective awareness?
premises: Anything may be reflected on inwardly or outwardly.
Before its form is unfolded, it still appears.
This appearance is the first stage of apprehension.
inference: Whatever is reflected on, inwardly or outwardly, first shines forth with its form not yet unfolded.
plain_english: Here, whatever is reflected on, whether inwardly or outwardly, first shines forth with its form not yet unfolded.
